title: A trophy night, then a drone
summary: A drone interruption paused Thursday night football at Lambeau Field. The Brewers also brought their World Series trophy to the game; the shared evening is documented, not a demonstrated connection.

timeline.label: Celebration
timeline.text: Milwaukee players attended with their championship trophy.

timeline.label: Third quarter
timeline.text: Play paused with Green Bay ahead 20–10 while a drone was reported near the stadium.

timeline.label: Restart
timeline.text: Yahoo’s broadcast account reports a Josh Jacobs touchdown reception on the next play.

unusual: An aerial safety interruption and a baseball championship celebration occurred on the same football night.
explanations: Officials paused for safety. No reviewed source links the drone operator or purpose to the Brewers celebration.
questions: Who operated the drone? Was any official enforcement outcome announced?
